crossRefs.note: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness…
Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.
Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. God will send out his loving kindness and…
He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able…

translations.web: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
translations.bsb: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.
translations.kjv: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve
translations.asv: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Jehovah; Let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
